The language orthographies in src/linux/font_orth.inc are generated by tools/make-font-orth.py from
fontconfig 2.15.0's fc-lang/*.orth files (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/fontconfig/fontconfig).
They are lists of the code points each language needs; no fontconfig code is used. The files read
(en ja ko zh_cn zh_tw zh_hk ar he th hi fa und_zsye de fr es it pt nl sv da nb no fi pl cs hu ro tr
ru uk el vi id ms) carry these notices:
